aboutParagraphs: I started in graphic design, but curiosity pulled me toward Product Design—the field where I wanted to be. Over the past six years, I've worked on internal platforms, mobile apps, SaaS products, and websites. My focus is understanding processes, finding where they break, and turning them into simple, cohesive products that serve both users and the business.
I'm meticulous about consistency and visual detail. I believe thoughtful interactions and well-designed components make experiences memorable and build trust.
Outside work, I enjoy music, film, sports, and reading. I like making things, understanding how they work, and staying curious.
servicesDescription: I combine strategy, product design, systems thinking, and front-end development to turn complex problems into clear, cohesive experiences built to scale.
